#  Steelers select Smith in sixth round
*   *   *   * Copied!

**Sutton Smith  
Linebacker  
Northern Illinois  
6-0, 232  
Saint Charles, Mo.  
Francis Howell High School  
6th Round â 175th Overall**

**CAREER NOTES**  
Became the first two-time first team All-American in Northern Illinois football historyâ¦two-time MAC Defensive Player of the Year (2017 and 2018)â¦ranks third all-time in program history in sacks (30.0) and second in tackles for loss (58).

**2018 SEASON**  
First Team All-Americanâ¦recipient of the MAC's Vern Smith Leadership award (MVP) and repeated as the league's Defensive Player of the Yearâ¦Ted Hendricks Award finalistâ¦amassed 61 total tackles (43 solo), breaking his own school record for sacks in a season (15.0) with 2.0 coming in the MAC Championship gameâ¦posted at least one tackle for loss in 12 of 14 games, and had a sack in nine gamesâ¦earned MAC West Defensive Player of the Week honors with 2.0 sacks, two fumble recoveries, including a strip-sack vs. Ohio (Oct. 13)â¦collected a career-best 4.0 sacks, five tackles for loss, and an 85-yard fumble return for a touchdown at Western Michigan (Nov. 20), earning his third MAC West Player of the Week honorsâ¦named Defensive MVP with a career high 10 tackle performance in the MAC title game vs. Buffalo (Nov. 30).

**2017 SEASON**  
Program's second all-time Consensus All-Americanâ¦MAC Defensive Player of the Year and Ted Hendricks Award finalistâ¦broke NIU records for sacks (14.0) and tackles for loss in a season (29.5), and scored twice on fumble returnsâ¦generated 63 total tackles (43 solo)â¦earned MAC West Defensive Player of the Week honors three timesâ¦at Nebraska (Sept. 16), posted 2.0 sacks, six tackles and a pass defensedâ¦posted a career-high 10 tackles with four stops for loss and 3.0 sacks vs. Kent State (Oct. 7)â¦made five-and-a-half tackles for loss and scored his second fumble return of the season vs. Western Michigan (Nov. 15), with a 58-yard score.

**2016 SEASON**  
Posted 15 tackles (6 solo), a sack and two tackle for loss, appearing in 12 games as a reserve defensive endâ¦recorded his first career sack at Western Michigan (Oct. 8).

**2015 SEASON**  
Redshirt.

**HIGH SCHOOL**  
Played at Francis Howell (Saint Charles, Mo.)â¦tallied 2,456 all-purpose yards with more than 2,000 from rushing and 32 total touchdownsâ¦helped program to an 11-1 record and advance to the Missouri 6A state semifinals in 2014 senior seasonâ¦tabbed 2014 _St. Louis Dispatch_ All-Metro Offensive Player of the Yearâ¦gained 1,682 all-purpose yards and 18 total touchdowns as a junior.
